title: LikenessConsent
description: LIKENESS-01. One change to a household adult's consent about their own likeness, appended each time the person switches one of the two consent settings (likeness.adults, likeness.adult_content) on or off. The settings hold the current value; this record is the history: who agreed to what, and when. Only the person themselves writes it, from their own settings, and only an adult. Records are never edited or deleted.

person_id.description: The person whose likeness this is (the subject), who made the change.

option.description: adults: other adults here may make pictures, videos and styles that look like this person. adult_content: and may include adult content (only meaningful while adults is on).

source.description: How the change was made; this is the record provenance. Only the person's own settings page writes it.
